label: local-m4
mix: one sheet, 100,000 rows: A = n, B = A*2 on every row, C1 = SUM(B1:B100000) (200,001 cells, stored with id references); open = build the opencalc workbook from the block and compute every cell (oc_sheet::engine::Book::open); edit = set A50000 and answer the changed displays (Book::set). Native release build, one thread, no network, no Yjs.

before.linearLookups: MemGrid row/column lookups by linear search and one engine edit (with its recalculation) per cell: no result after 300 s (stopped)
before.indexOnly: indexed lookups, still one engine edit per cell (each rebuilds the dependency graph): no result after 150 s (stopped)

notes: The edit time is the engine's recalculation plus re-reading every cell's display (Book::refresh walks all 200,001 cells); narrowing refresh to the cells the engine recomputed is the next step if edits on large sheets need to be faster.
